entities.name: PMID:25089004
observations: 2015 Acta Physiologica study directly measured macula-densa NO, superoxide, and TGF response in control and slow-pressor Ang II hypertensive mice.

entities.name: MD redox tunes TGF
observations: In mice infused with Ang II 600 ng/kg/min for 2 weeks, TGF response rose from 3.4 ± 0.2 to 5.2 ± 0.2 μm; MD superoxide rose from undetectable to 21.4 ± 2.5 units/min and NO fell from 138.5 ± 9.3 to undetectable.
Authors concluded control TGF depends mainly on MD-derived NO under physiological conditions but mainly on MD-derived superoxide during Ang II hypertension.
